text:
Maya: Heads up — I'm landing a small docs PR to switch the structured output examples to the compact envelope we agreed on. Ping if anyone is relying on the old shape.
Liam: Nice, thanks. Can you add a tiny SDK snippet for Python + TS showing a parse fallback example? That's what most integrators ask for. :+1:
Maya: Yep planning to add both. Draft is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 (WIP) — @Liam I’ll drop the snippet in /sdk_snippets/
pr-bot: PR opened by Maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — status: draft
Ashley: Quick note — QA found an old link in `invoke-guide.md` that points to the long-envelope examples. Can you sweep links? I can run a grep script and push fixes if you want.
Maya: Good catch. I’ll run a search/replace for references to "full envelope" -> "legacy full-envelope" and add redirects. Also planning a short changelog entry: "Prefer compact envelope examples"
Sam: Can we keep one canonical full-envelope example under a legacy section? Some customers still use the old output format. Also would be great to include a small migration checklist.
Maya: Absolutely — will keep a "Legacy formats" subsection under Examples and add a migration checklist with code snippets + test vectors.
Liam: For the SDK snippets, suggest something like:
```python
# python parse fallback example
from redwood import parse_structured
try:
    result = parse_structured(resp, schema=my_schema)
except ParseError:
    # fallback: treat as plain text or call the fallback parser
    result = fallback_handle(resp)
```
and a short TS equivalent showing `unknown` -> validated type.
Maya: Pushed updates to the PR: added `sdk_snippets/python.md` and `sdk_snippets/ts.md` with the fallback examples, link fixes, and a small unit test for the snippet harness. Ready for review.
Ashley: Quick review: minor nit — the TS snippet used `any` in one spot, can we tighten that to `unknown` and narrow types after validation? Also spotted a stray link to `/docs/old-toolcall` that 404s.
Maya: Fixed the `any` -> `unknown` and updated that link to the new `/examples/legacy/full-envelope`. Thanks! Will merge after one more approval. @Sam could you glance when you have a sec?
Sam: :thumbsup: will review in ~15m. Also, can someone add an example for the `function_call` edge-case where the tool returns `null`? We should show an explicit fallback branch for that case.
Maya: Good idea — added a "null tool output" snippet and an accompanying test vector. Plan to merge in ~20m unless more feedback.
